title: Wirelang Layer 1 — Wire Format (CloudEvents 1.0 + Wakir Extensions)
description: Schema for Wakir Wirelang frames. A Wakir frame is a CloudEvents 1.0 envelope with eight Wakir-reserved extension attributes.

specversion.description: CloudEvents spec version. Wakir is fixed to 1.0.

type.description: Reverse-DNS event type. Matches the NATS subject's <event-type> token.

source.description: DID of the sending agent. Phase-1 only allows did:web.

id.description: Event id. Wakir convention: UUIDv7 for time-ordered hash-stable sorting.

time.description: RFC 3339 timestamp. Wakir frames MUST set this even though CloudEvents marks it OPTIONAL.

datacontenttype.description: Content type of the data payload. Wakir default: application/wirelang+json.

dataschema.description: URI of the schema-registry entry that 'data' conforms to.

subject.description: Optional CloudEvents subject. Free for application use.

data.description: Wirelang Layer-2 semantic payload. Validated by the schema referenced via 'schemaid'+'schemaversion'.

schemaid.description: Schema-registry identifier. Reverse-DNS, identical in shape to 'type'.

actorrole.description: Role of the sending agent (audit-specialist, treasury-operator, ...). Pseudonymisation field. No clear name.

caprefs.description: List of Layer-3 capability-token hashes carried by this frame. Validity is checked at Layer 3, not here.

attestationref.description: TEE-attestation report hash. Reserved for V-904 phase 3.

personahash.description: Hash of the agent's persona-markdown definition. Reserved for V-907 phase 3.

imagedigest.description: Container image digest of the sending agent. Reserved for phase-1b container provenance.

dataschemaref.description: Optional alternate or pinned schema-document reference. Used when 'dataschema' carries a registry alias and the consumer needs the resolved location.

agentid.description: Stable agent identifier within the sending org. Pseudonymisation-compatible (no clear name). Independent of 'source' DID for cross-org federation per ADR-0031.

personapin.description: Persona-pinning hash. Distinct from 'personahash': a 'pin' is a deployment-time commitment and may differ from the runtime persona-markdown hash during overlapping migration windows.
